scope: Actual launch, empty-folder and filtered no-selection safety, responsiveness, clean shutdown and separate reviewed screenshots; not whole-product visual certification.

native.count_rule: Mixed UI/native acceptance cases; not Go unit tests, not added to earlier suite totals.

binding.rule: Successful build receipt, exact HEAD, clean checkout, branch/origin, manifest hash, each source file and copied executable verified before use; source rechecked afterward.

filesystem.checks: Empty source remains empty; filtered physical sentinel retains exact filename/bytes; destination remains empty; no operation journal entries are appended.

visual_review.reviewer: assistant inspection of the four actual images returned by Remote Desktop Commander

captures.name: DCM-17-empty-launch
captures.observations: Visible version 1.0.71 and Empty Inbox path; FILES 0, No files remaining, Folder complete, blank draft, disabled Undo/Undo Batch and preview tools.

captures.name: DCM-17-empty-after-actions
captures.observations: Same empty state after Rename, Move, Next and Reload; Accepted destination remains displayed; no error dialog or spurious file/history.

captures.name: DCM-17-no-selection
captures.observations: No-match filter visible, zero displayed/selected files and blank filename draft; no stale preview. Folder complete wording is inaccurate for filtered results and remains an open follow-up.

captures.name: DCM-17-restored-selection
captures.observations: Clear Filters restores selected 01-sentinel.txt, FILES 1 of 1, correct filename draft and readable sentinel text preview. No processed history is falsely created.
